gotchas.text: Atlas publishes no releases and every build reports the same version string (spark 1.0.0-beta-preview), so the engine version registered for this run is the git commit, as the sparkinfer entry does. engine.build carries Atlas-Inf/atlas@bdcccc2c.

The published container azeezish/atlas-gb10:latest (digest sha256:faa6e5820c42dd86d0ae9e12cbaf2a2e9f32d0f7a9ab348a75ee54d4253929a6) CANNOT run these recipes: its spark serve --help has no --prefill-varlen-batch and its --ssm-h-dtype accepts only f32 and f16, not f16-pool. Both landed in Atlas-Inf/atlas#572 on 2026-08-18 and the image predates them despite a later tag date. This run is therefore a source build, not that image.
The engine will not link with default cargo features: NCCL is a default feature and libnccl is absent on a single-box DGX Spark. Build with --no-default-features --features cuda.

This configuration runs with almost no host memory to spare. On a 119.6 GB unified-memory GB10 at --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, the latency profile leaves ~2.8 GB free at idle and troughs at ~1.25 GB under this workload - LESS headroom than the concurrency profile's ~5.5 GB, despite max-batch-size 8 against 128, because --max-seq-len 32768 and 64 Marconi snapshot slots at ~151.5 MiB each dominate. Size a GB10 from sequence length and ssm-cache-slots, not from batch size.

Four of this configuration's knobs have no CLI flag and are read from the environment (ATLAS_PREFILL_CODISPATCH, ATLAS_FP8_ROWWISE, ATLAS_MTP_DCUT_RATIO, ATLAS_MTP_K_LADDER). The published recipe says the ladder does not reproduce without them, so they are registered as engine params and passed in args; a fingerprint that dropped them would merge two configurations that differ by more than 20% at C=2.
Configuration is the published recipe Atlas-Inf/sparkrun-recipes recipes/qwen3.8/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-latency.yaml verbatim.

provenance.notes: Box idle: no other GPU work, no compile, one model resident. reiner / gx10-e3a3, NVIDIA GB10 DGX Spark, 119.6 GB unified, driver 580.126.09, CUDA 13.0, Ubuntu 24.04.4, kernel 6.17.0-1008-nvidia. Ambient temperature not measured. Engine is a source build of Atlas-Inf/atlas at bdcccc2c, not the published container - see gotchas. This workload was measured on a second attempt: a first attempt under this same configuration was terminated at request ~204 of 608 by an operator memory watchdog set at 1250 MB, which is above this configuration's healthy trough; no result file was produced by that attempt and nothing here replaces one.
